decision: vector strings are well-formed UTF-16 and generated ops cut only between code points
why: serde_json cannot parse a lone surrogate into a Rust string, so a vector holding one could not be read; positions still count UTF-16 units
evidence: tools/gen-ot-vectors.mjs randomOp; tests/convergence.rs cuts at any unit, lone surrogates included
result: vectors cover CRLF, pairs, emoji, line strategy, block fallback, char and line fallbacks

decision: from_json rejects integers above 2^53-1, which JavaScript accepts
why: such a length cannot describe any real text and would overflow; the hub answers resync either way
without it vsce would pack the Rust workspace and lane 10 requires nothing under lanhub/ in the vsix

decision: randomized tests use a seeded LCG with no proptest dependency, and the bench is a harness=false binary with no criterion
why: the workspace stays on serde and serde_json only, and the bench must share an exact PRNG and checksum with the JavaScript bench
result: equal fnv checksums prove both benches ran the same workload

decision: flipped the transform tie-break in a scratch edit (op 2 insert first) and reran cargo test -p lanhub-ot, then restored the file
why: the vector test must prove it catches a semantic change, not only pass
